rv.q: Samuel Beckett remains the theater's pre-eminent master of compression.
F. Murray Abraham dazzles as Krapp in this entrancing triple bill by the Nobel laureate.

His version, available on YouTube is perhaps definitive. Murray Abraham, this Krapp has to be ranked one of the best ever. In its 46 minutes this is the most impressive performance now on any New York City stage.
Abraham is giving a masterclass in Beckett's brand of wistful existentialism as Krapp
...a relatively painless, if baffling, 75 minutes, and probably pretty good Beckett.
A fascinating dive into the purpose of the human life cycle...
F. Murray Abraham brings a grounded physicality to Beckett’s Krapp.
